ACADEMIC PROJECTS
Smart Grid IoT Energy Monitoring Node
Technologies: Embedded C, ESP32, FreeRTOS, MQTT, AWS IoT Core
• Architected low-power firmware on ESP32 microcontroller reading voltage and current sensors via ADC at 100Hz sampling rate.
• Implemented FreeRTOS preemptive multitasking with separate tasks for sensor acquisition, telemetry queue, and WiFi transmission.
• Integrated MQTT over TLS sending packet payloads to AWS IoT Core with deep-sleep power management, reducing power consumption by 40%.

CAN Bus Engine Telemetry Diagnostic Logger
Technologies: C++, STM32F407, CAN 2.0B, FreeRTOS
• Designed firmware for STM32 communicating over CAN 2.0B interface at 500 kbps to log standard OBD-II diagnostic parameters.
• Implemented circular ring buffer for zero data loss during high bus saturation up to 80% bus load.
• Filtered and saved sensor readings to on-board SPI Flash memory module with CRC32 integrity verification.
